sources.title: ThakiOCR-KO-v1: We Released a LoRA That Adapts OvisOCR3 to Korean Word ...
sources.snippet: We trained a LoRA adapter for Korean word recognition on top of the open OCR model OvisOCR3 and released it as ThakiCloud/ThakiOCR-KO-v1. On 2,400 word crops from our internal development set, the character error rate (CER) went from 25.28% for the base model to 7.78%, a 69.2% relative reduction.
